sections.text:
-Ability Power 220. Damages all enemies 2 times with physical fire damage at success of 100 points.
Ability Power boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
-Increases the stats of all allies by 50% for 60 seconds.
-Increases fire, water, wind, light, dark, time, and star elemental attack for all allies by 4 for 60 seconds.
-Reduces Ability cooldown times (except for certain Abilities) for all allies by 30% for 50 seconds.
-Recovers 10% of max HP for all allies every 5 seconds for 60 seconds.
-Recovers 20 Cost for your character.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 6000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 6000
